app.Response.description: The Response struct is used for wrapping the API response with a code, message, and data.

code.description:
Code is the HTTP status code or a custom code used to indicate the result of the request
@example 200

data.description:
Data is the response data (can be any object or null)
@example {"id": 1, "name": "John Doe"}

msg.description:
Msg is the message that describes the result of the request
@example "Request successful"

info.description: Crawlora is a hosted web-data and SERP API: call documented REST endpoints and get normalized JSON instead of HTML to parse — across search/SERP, maps and local, e-commerce, app stores, social, media and finance. One API key; Crawlora runs the proxy rotation, headless browsers and parsing behind the scenes. Billed pay-on-success: charged only on a successful 2xx response, 1-10 credits per call, with a free tier of 2,000 credits per month and no card. A hosted MCP server (mcp.crawlora.net/mcp) exposes the same catalog as agent tools. Search endpoints accept `q` as a universal alias for whichever search-term parameter they document (`query`, `term`, `keyword`, or Amazon's `k`), so one parameter name works across the whole catalog; an explicitly supplied documented name always wins.
info.title: Crawlora API

get.description: Returns Dota 2 abilities from OpenDota's constants table as compact summaries (key, display name, behavior, target team and type, damage type, dispellable, BKB pierce, cooldown, mana cost, innate flag, description), sorted by key. Internal helper entries without a display name are skipped. `q` searches the key and display name.

parameters.description: Case-insensitive search on the ability key or display name, for example blink
parameters.name: q

parameters.description: Number of abilities to return, 1 to 500; defaults to 50
parameters.name: limit

get.description: Returns a Dota 2 hero's benchmark percentiles from OpenDota's public games: for each of ten per-minute metrics (`gold_per_min`, `xp_per_min`, `kills_per_min`, `deaths_per_min`, `assists_per_min`, `last_hits_per_min`, `denies_per_min`, `hero_damage_per_min`, `hero_healing_per_min`, `tower_damage`) the value at percentiles 0.1 to 0.99, sorted by percentile. An unknown hero id returns 404.

parameters.description: Positive hero ID from opendota-heroes
parameters.name: hero_id

parameters.description: Rank bracket 1 (Herald) to 8 (Immortal) to benchmark against; omit for all ranks
parameters.name: bracket

parameters.description: Role of the games counted; one of core, support; omit for all roles
parameters.name: role

get.summary: OpenDota Dota 2 hero benchmarks by percentile

get.description: Returns one OpenDota lookup table as a sorted list of `id`/`name` entries, used to decode ids in match data: game modes and lobby types (with `balanced`), patches (with release `date`), regions, server clusters (`value` is the region id), item and ability ids, permanent buff ids, experience thresholds per level (`value`) countries (`id` is the ISO code), order types (`order_types`, the unit order names) player slot colors (`player_colors`, hex colors), chat wheel phrases (`chat_wheel`, `name` is the label and `text` the message), item rarity colors (`item_colors`, `text` is the hex color), neutral ancient creeps (`ancients`) and skillshot abilities (`skillshots`). `resource` is one of `game_mode`, `lobby_type`, `patch`, `region`, `cluster`, `item_ids`, `ability_ids`, `permanent_buffs`, `xp_level`, `countries`.

parameters.description: Lookup table; one of game_mode, lobby_type, patch, region, cluster, item_ids, ability_ids, permanent_buffs, xp_level, countries, order_types, player_colors, chat_wheel, item_colors, ancients, skillshots
parameters.name: resource

get.description: Returns recent public Dota 2 matches in which the given heroes were on team A and/or team B, with both full lineups (radiant and dire), whether Radiant won, and which side the requested team A heroes were on and whether they won. Provide at least one hero id in total; each side takes up to 5 comma-separated hero ids from opendota-heroes. Unknown or repeated hero ids return an invalid-parameter error.

parameters.description: Comma-separated hero ids (up to 5) that must be on team A
parameters.name: team_a

parameters.description: Comma-separated hero ids (up to 5) that must be on team B
parameters.name: team_b

get.summary: OpenDota Dota 2 matches by hero lineup

get.description: Returns, for every Dota 2 hero or for one `hero_id`, what Aghanim's Scepter and Aghanim's Shard do: whether each upgrade exists, its description, the skill it changes and whether it adds a new skill. `include_lore=true` adds each hero's lore text (about 155 KB for all heroes), so it is off by default. An unknown hero id returns not found. Take `hero_id` from opendota-heroes.

parameters.description: Positive hero id from opendota-heroes; omit it for all heroes
parameters.name: hero_id

parameters.description: true adds each hero's lore text; defaults to false
parameters.name: include_lore

get.summary: OpenDota Dota 2 Aghanim's Scepter and Shard descriptions

get.description: Returns a hero's games and wins grouped by game length in five-minute bins (`start_minute` is the bin's first minute), sorted by length, to show whether the hero is stronger early or late. An unknown hero id returns not found.

parameters.description: Positive hero ID from opendota-heroes
parameters.name: hero_id

get.summary: OpenDota Dota 2 hero win rate by game duration

get.description: Returns the items players buy on a hero in four phases (`start_game`, `early_game`, `mid_game`, `late_game`), each sorted by purchase count, with item ids resolved to internal names such as `power_treads` through the item-id table. An unknown hero id returns not found.

parameters.description: Positive hero ID from opendota-heroes
parameters.name: hero_id

get.description: Returns recent professional and public matches in which a hero was played (about 100), each with the side it played, whether it won, its kills, deaths and assists, duration and league when there is one. Players' account ids are not returned. An unknown hero id returns not found.

parameters.description: Positive hero ID from opendota-heroes
parameters.name: hero_id

get.summary: OpenDota Dota 2 recent matches of a hero

get.description: Returns how often a hero faced each other hero in recent public games and how often it won, sorted by games played, with localized hero names and win-rate percentages. An unknown hero id returns not found.

parameters.description: Positive hero ID from opendota-heroes
parameters.name: hero_id

get.description: Returns every Dota 2 hero with base stats (health, mana, armor, attack range, move speed) and OpenDota's aggregate pick/win counts and win rates for professional games (with bans), public games, turbo, and each of the eight rank brackets (`Herald`, `Guardian`, `Crusader`, `Archon`, `Legend`, `Ancient`, `Divine`, `Immortal`). Filter by `primary_attr` (`agi`, `all`, `int`, `str`), `attack_type` (`Melee`, `Ranged`) and `role`, sort with `sort` and `desc`, and cap with `limit`. Win rates are percentages and are omitted when there are no picks.

parameters.description: Primary attribute filter; one of agi, all, int, str
parameters.name: primary_attr

parameters.description: Attack type filter; one of Melee, Ranged
parameters.name: attack_type

parameters.description: Role filter; one of Carry, Disabler, Durable, Escape, Initiator, Nuker, Pusher, Support
parameters.name: role

parameters.description: Sort key; one of id, name, pro_pick, pro_win, pro_ban, pro_win_rate, pub_pick, pub_win, pub_win_rate, turbo_pick, turbo_win_rate; defaults to id
parameters.name: sort

parameters.description: Sort descending (the default for every key except id and name)
parameters.name: desc

parameters.description: Number of heroes to return, 1 to 200; defaults to all
parameters.name: limit

get.summary: OpenDota Dota 2 hero pick and win statistics

get.description: Returns the live OpenDota hero lookup needed to resolve `hero_id` values in live and detailed match responses. It includes every current hero ID with its internal name, localized name, primary attribute (`agi`, `all`, `int`, or `str`) and attack type (`Melee` or `Ranged`).

Returns Dota 2 items from OpenDota's constants table as compact summaries (key, id, display name, quality, gold cost, behavior, cooldown, mana cost, components, active and passive abilities, numeric attributes), sorted by key. `q` searches the key and display name, `quality` filters by quality, and `qualities` lists the quality values present.

parameters.description: Case-insensitive search on the item key or display name, for example blink
parameters.name: q

parameters.description: Item quality from the qualities list in the response; currently artifact, common, component, consumable, consumable;laning, epic, rare, secret_shop
parameters.name: quality

parameters.description: Number of items to return, 1 to 500; defaults to 50
parameters.name: limit

get.description: Returns one league's name, tier (`amateur`, `excluded`, `premium`, `professional` or `unrated` when blank), ticket and banner, plus the teams that played in it with rating and record. An unknown league id returns not found.

parameters.description: Positive OpenDota league ID from opendota-leagues
parameters.name: league_id

get.summary: OpenDota Dota 2 league detail and teams

get.description: Returns match IDs for one league, including amateur leagues omitted from opendota_league_matches. An empty array is valid for a league with no matches. Copy an ID into opendota_match for match details.

parameters.description: Positive OpenDota league ID from opendota_leagues
parameters.name: league_id

get.summary: OpenDota match IDs for one league

get.description: Returns the complete match list supplied for one OpenDota league, including match ID, teams, scores, start time and series metadata. Optionally filter locally to matches involving one team; league_id and team_id are echoed. This source route is not paginated and can include completed or scheduled rows; use opendota_match for parsed player statistics.

parameters.description: Positive league ID from opendota_leagues
parameters.name: league_id

parameters.description: Optional positive team ID; keeps matches where this team is Radiant or Dire
parameters.name: team_id

get.description: Returns every league ID and its source name, ticket, banner and tier. The source list is large and can include historical or excluded leagues. Filter `tier` locally; `unrated` selects source rows whose tier is blank. The response echoes tier_filter. Use a returned ID with opendota_league_matches.

parameters.description: Optional exact source tier filter
parameters.name: tier

get.description: Returns OpenDota's current top live Dota 2 games: match and league IDs, team names, score, game clock, net-worth lead, player names when exposed, raw hero IDs, the upstream team code (`0` or `1`), and team slot (`1`, `2`, `3`, `4`, or `5`). The source mixes public matchmaking with tournament games; `league_id` is `0` when no league is associated, so its presence alone does not certify a professional event. `delay_seconds` and `last_update_time` report source freshness. Live player K/D/A is not provided by this endpoint. Resolve `hero_id` values with opendota_heroes.

Returns a compact parsed match summary and player lines for one numeric OpenDota match ID. Copy the ID from opendota_live, opendota_pro_matches, opendota_league_matches, or opendota_league_match_ids. Replay-derived player data can be absent or delayed; a missing match ID returns not found. Steam account IDs, chat logs, replay salts and raw telemetry are not returned. `hero_id` is resolved with opendota_heroes.

parameters.description: Positive OpenDota match ID from live, pro-match, league-match, or league-match-ID results
parameters.name: id

get.description: Without `patch`, lists every patch key OpenDota has notes for (from 7_06d to the current patch) in chronological order with the number of heroes and items changed. With `patch` (for example `7_38`), returns that patch's general notes, item changes and hero changes (general, talents and per-ability notes, with the hero id and name resolved).

parameters.description: Patch key such as 7_38 or 7_06d; omit it to list every patch key
parameters.name: patch

get.description: Returns professional Dota 2 match summaries with match ID, teams, league, start time, duration, scores, winner and series metadata. OpenDota returns up to 100 rows per page. Set `less_than_match_id` to a positive match ID to fetch older results; use `next_less_than_match_id` from the response for the next page. An empty cursor page is the end of history. This is recent results, not an upcoming-match schedule. Use opendota_match with one returned match ID for parsed player statistics.

parameters.description: Return professional matches with IDs lower than this positive match ID; copy next_less_than_match_id from the previous response
parameters.name: less_than_match_id

get.description: Returns a sanitized, searchable page of the OpenDota pro-player roster with player names, country codes and team tags. The upstream sends an unfiltered roster without pagination; this endpoint caches it and applies team_id, q, limit and offset locally. q searches names, tags and country codes. Account IDs, Steam IDs, profile URLs and avatars are omitted.

parameters.description: Optional positive team ID from opendota_teams
parameters.name: team_id

parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring in player/team names, team tags or country codes; maximum 200 characters
parameters.name: q

parameters.description: Local page size, default 50, maximum 100
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Zero-based local offset, default 0
parameters.name: offset

get.description: Returns about 100 recent ranked public Dota 2 matches with the heroes on each side, game mode, lobby type and average rank tier, optionally limited to a rank range. Rank tiers are the medal (1 Herald, 2 Guardian, 3 Crusader, 4 Archon, 5 Legend, 6 Ancient, 7 Divine, 8 Immortal) times ten plus stars 1 to 5. Page back with `less_than_match_id` set to the previous `next_less_than_match_id`. Players' account ids are not returned.

parameters.description: Lowest average rank tier, medal 1-8 times ten plus stars 1-5
parameters.name: min_rank

parameters.description: Highest average rank tier, same form as min_rank; not below min_rank
parameters.name: max_rank

parameters.description: Return matches older than this match id
parameters.name: less_than_match_id

get.summary: OpenDota Dota 2 recent public matches by rank

get.description: Returns how OpenDota's rated players are distributed over Dota 2 rank tiers: for each `rank_tier` (the first digit is the medal, the second the stars) the medal name, stars, player count, cumulative count and the share and cumulative share in percent, sorted by tier.

Returns the top 100 single-match records for one stat (`kills`, `deaths`, `assists`, `last_hits`, `denies`, `gold_per_min`, `xp_per_min`, `hero_damage`, `tower_damage`, `hero_healing`, `duration`): rank, match id, start time, hero (with name) and the record value. Use opendota-match with a returned match id.

parameters.description: Record field; one of kills, deaths, assists, last_hits, denies, gold_per_min, xp_per_min, hero_damage, tower_damage, hero_healing, duration
parameters.name: field

get.description: Returns OpenDota's scenario datasets as games, wins and win rate rows, most games first. `kind` selects `item-timings` (an item bought by a time for a hero), `lane-roles` (a hero in a lane role at a time) or `misc` (courier kill, first blood and chat scenarios by side and region). Filters are validated before any upstream call: `hero_id` and `item` apply to item-timings, `hero_id` and `lane_role` to lane-roles, `scenario` to misc.

parameters.description: Dataset; one of item-timings, lane-roles, misc
parameters.name: kind

parameters.description: Positive hero ID from opendota-heroes; item-timings and lane-roles only
parameters.name: hero_id

parameters.description: Item name from opendota-constants item_ids, for example bfury; item-timings only
parameters.name: item

parameters.description: Lane role 1 to 4 (1 safe lane, 2 mid, 3 off lane, 4 jungle); lane-roles only
parameters.name: lane_role

parameters.description: Scenario; one of courier_kill, first_blood, neg_chat_1min, pos_chat_1min; misc only
parameters.name: scenario

parameters.description: Number of rows to return, 1 to 2000, most games first; defaults to all
parameters.name: limit

get.description: Returns one team's OpenDota profile, tag, logo, rating, wins, losses and most recent match metadata.

parameters.description: Positive OpenDota team ID from opendota_teams or a match response
parameters.name: team_id

get.description: Returns the heroes a team has played with games, wins and win rate, sorted by games played. Heroes the team never played are omitted. An unknown team id returns not found.

parameters.description: Positive OpenDota team ID from opendota-teams or a match response
parameters.name: team_id

get.description: Returns a team's complete upstream match history with league, opponent, score and winner data. The source does not paginate this list; large histories can contain over a thousand rows. Use opendota_match for parsed player statistics.

parameters.description: Positive OpenDota team ID from opendota_teams or a match response
parameters.name: team_id

get.description: Returns the players who have played for a team with games played, wins and whether they are a current member, current members first. Steam account ids are not returned. An unknown team id returns not found.

parameters.description: Positive OpenDota team ID from opendota-teams or a match response
parameters.name: team_id

get.description: Returns a zero-based page of OpenDota team records with team IDs, names, tags, ranking and recent-match metadata. OpenDota returns up to 1000 teams per page; use `next_page` while present. Use a team ID with opendota_team or opendota_team_matches.

parameters.description: Zero-based page index; defaults to 0
parameters.name: page
